evidence: The phase composition of the films was determined by the grazing incidence X-ray diffraction (GIXRD) method. Ellipsometry and X-ray fluorescence spectrometry were applied to characterize the film thickness while time-of-flight elastic recoil detection analysis (TOF-ERDA) with Br projectiles was used to measure the concentration of residual iodine and hydrogen in the films. The film–substrate interface was studied by the high-resolution transmission electron microscopy (HRTEM) method while the composition of the interface layer was determined with an energy-dispersive spectrometer (EDS). The dielectric constant of HfO was calculated from the capacitance–voltage (C–V) curves of MOS structures, which were formed by evaporating aluminum electrodes on HfO films.
